The study matching your query is **PMID 25098850**, “Surgeons often underestimate the amount of blood loss in replacement surgeries.” In this prospective study of 140 total hip or total knee replacement patients, surgeon-estimated blood loss was below calculated blood loss in **98 patients (70%)** and above it in **42 (30%)**. Estimation accuracy declined when average blood loss exceeded 500 mL.
